widgets_values: rv2v — 参考素材改视频(Reference Video Edit)

Replace the single main person in <Video 1> with the person depicted in <Picture 1> throughout the entire video.

<Picture 1> defines the TARGET person: reproduce their facial identity, facial structure, hairstyle, skin tone, visible body proportions, clothing and accessories. Replace the source person's appearance, including their outfit, with this target appearance. Do not retain or blend in the source person's face.

If <Picture 1> is a three-view character sheet, all front, side and back views depict the SAME ONE person. Use the views only to understand that person's appearance across angles. Render only one replacement person in the video. Never render the sheet, panels, labels, multiple copies, or a split screen. Do not copy the reference background or standing pose.

<Video 1> defines the performance and scene: preserve the original action sequence, gestures, head turns, facial expressions, gaze, mouth motion, speech timing, body position, camera motion, framing and duration. Retarget that performance naturally to the target person. Do not invent a new performance.

Preserve the source background, lighting direction, scenery, and all non-person objects. Preserve any held product's shape, color, packaging, logo, visible text, scale and hand contact as closely as possible. Reconstruct natural contact shadows and occlusions around the replacement person. Match the source scene's illumination on the new person.

Maintain the same target identity and outfit from first to last frame and across segment boundaries. No identity drift, duplicate people, extra limbs, warped hands, new objects, added captions, added watermark, scene changes or camera redesign. Keep the original speech mouth timing; no new dialogue.

nodes.title: 05 人物替换｜上传源视频 + Picture 1人物参考图

widgets_values:
# H3 视频人物替换｜视频 + 一张人物图

## 操作
1. 在 05 Director 内上传源视频。模式保持 rv2v。
2. 开启公共参数，在图片1 / Picture 1 上传目标人物图。三视图也放在这一个槽位，不要当成3个人。
3. 检查全局提示词仍为 Replace the single main person 开头；检查公共参数已开启，所有片段共用图片1。
4. 上传后按真实视频时长重新均分或智能分割。建议先用4–6秒单人视频验证，再处理长视频；长视频可从每段约5–8秒开始。
5. 声音选择「使用原声 / source」；不需要额外上传音频。原视频无声则没有原声可保留。
6. 默认最长边640，保持源画面比例并按节点规则取整；测试通过可调864。默认24fps，运动节奏由源时间轴重采样，不等于保留原始帧率。
7. 检查全部片段选中后运行，在07保存视频。

## 替换范围
默认替换人物脸、头发、肤色、体型外观、服装和配饰；动作、表情节奏、镜头和背景以原视频为准。
如只换身份不换衣服，将提示词中 clothing and accessories 和 outfit 替换要求改为：Keep the original clothing and accessories from <Video 1>; use <Picture 1> only for facial identity, hair and skin tone.

## 三视图准备
同一人、同一套服装、正侧背三视图，五官清楚，尽量无文字。三视图可尝试，但本工作流不自动拆图或重建3D人物。人脸占比太小会削弱身份参考，可先用单人清晰正面或四分之三视角全身图测试。
